reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Stellia Games，发行商同名）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 232），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 逐字复刻商店披露的分析页，其内容仍是披露的转录而非独立核实；该页对制作方式给出的“AI 生成”归类只是其模型估计）。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作核查时尚未发售（商店页标注 Coming soon）。
disclosureQuote: The 3D models of some minions and items in the game were created using AI-generated technology.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-31 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A voxel-based open world survival crafting game. The developer states that the 3D models of some minions and items in the game were created using AI-generated technology.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Stellia Games, self-published) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 232); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read; the AI Transparency Index page reproduces the store disclosure verbatim and its production classification is a model estimate, not independent verification. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The game had not been released at review time (the store page lists Coming soon).
